examples.draft: Takamatsu is an incredibly renowned city throughout Japan for its udon, one of the country's three major noodle specialties. These udon noodles are distinctively white, fairly thick, and chewy. While the type produced within Kagawa Prefecture is sometimes called "Sanuki udon" (meaning Kagawa in the pre-modern era), this regional specialty is so widely loved across Japan that it is often mistaken for the "normal" udon. In fact, most people imagine the traditional udon when they simply hear the word "udon." Despite udon being so widespread, Takamatsu does it better and cheaper than anywhere else in the nation. There are literally hundreds of udon shops within the city limits. Because local foods are a primary driver of Japanese tourism, countless visitors flock to Takamatsu for the udon, often undertaking "chain-eating" tours to visit the city's most famous shops.

Discover the truth about alcohol consumption in our community! While the legal age to buy and consume alcohol is 18, you'll be surprised that many teenagers under 18 find it surprisingly easy to purchase alcohol in smaller pubs and off-licences. However, if you're over 18 but appear younger, be prepared to prove your age, especially in popular city spots. In fact, in certain locations, if you look under 21 or 25, you must prove you are over 18—a system known as "Challenge 21(25)." Additionally, some premises enforce proof-of-age requirements for all drinks after a specific time due to restrictions on who can be on-site.

For entry, the most trustworthy forms of ID are a passport or driving licence, which clearly display your photograph and date of birth. ID cards are generally accepted provided they include a photograph, and official proof-of-age cards are available for application via post, though please note they take several weeks to issue. Please be advised: any other form of ID will not be accepted. Conversely, in private residences, the minimum age to drink alcohol is 5 years old; however, if a 5 or 6-year-old (or similar) appears intoxicated, authorities may intervene and bring the matter before the courts as a case of child neglect.

Why we stopped billing by the hour — and never looked back. 🙌

When we started Fernway Studio, we did what every agency does: we charged hourly.

The result? 4 of our first 6 projects went over budget. 😬

Clients were frustrated. We were frustrated. Trust was eroding.

So in 2024, we made a bold decision. We switched to a fixed price: KES 450,000 per Shopify store. Period.

And it changed everything.

✅ Clients know exactly what they're paying
✅ We're incentivized to work smarter, not longer
✅ Relationships are built on trust, not timesheets

Since then, we've launched 31 stores. Only 2 went over our 6-week timeline.

Pricing isn't just a number. It's a promise. 💯

Founders — how do you price your services? Let me know in the comments!

#Entrepreneurship #Africa #Shopify #AgencyLife #Pricing
